verdict.rationale: Rootly documents generating API keys from Organization Settings and says Global API Keys are assigned an On-Call and Incident Response role when generated, so keys carry role-based permissions. The evidence does not show an admin narrowing a key to least privilege for an agent, and nothing ties these keys to agent or MCP use. missing for 10: documented way to choose or restrict scopes per key (e.g., read-only or per-resource), details on non-global/team-scoped key types, key expiry/rotation controls, guidance on agent- or MCP-specific credentials, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent

citations.quote: Global API Keys are assigned an On-Call and Incident Response role when they’re generated.
To generate a new API key, navigate to: **Organization dropdown** > **Organization Settings** > **API Keys > Generate New API Key**.
